name: Markaevi SEO Assistant
author: yagmuryurtsever

sections.description:
Markaevi SEO Assistant is a lightweight and professional SEO tool designed to handle your technical and on-page SEO without bloating your WordPress database.

Source Code & Build Tools

The complete, unminified source code for the React-based administration dashboard is included directly within this plugin package under the /src directory. The compiled assets in the /build directory are generated using standard @wordpress/scripts (Webpack configuration).

Features

  • On-Page SEO Live Checklist
  • Real-time Google Snippet Preview
  • Dynamic Virtual Sitemap.xml & Robots.txt generation
  • Support for Posts, Pages, and WooCommerce Products
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Markaevi SEO menu to manage your content.
